storyPillars.title: Connect
storyPillars.body: Every piece carries the imprint of the hand that made it. Wear it, and you carry the line back to the maker.

storyPillars.title: Create
storyPillars.body: Garments engineered like leather: tested by use, improved by wear. We make objects that earn their place in your closet.

storyPillars.title: Inspire
storyPillars.body: American iconography, refined for the way you actually live. Bold archetypes, quiet finish.

hero.body: At Il Mano Gallery, we envision a world where art, fashion, and philanthropy come together to inspire connection, creativity, and meaningful change.

editorial.imageAlt: The Field Set — hoodie & duffle on location
editorial.quote: Dust on the leather. Sun on the cotton. A wardrobe that ages with the road.
editorial.body: Shot on a single morning between Joshua Tree and Pioneertown — no stylist, no retouch. The Heritage Duffle and Tobacco Hoodie photographed where they belong: outside.

manifesto.statement: We carve garments like leather — tested by use, refined by wear, and made to outlast the trend cycle.
